response.sql: SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, qty_rank FROM (SELECT order_item_id, product_color, avg_quantity, avg_cost_ratio, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY product_color ORDER BY (avg_quantity IS NULL), avg_quantity DESC) AS qty_rank FROM (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS order_item_id, p.product_color AS product_color, AVG(CAST(ili.product_quantity AS REAL)) AS avg_quantity, AVG((ili.derived_product_cost - ili.derived_total_cost) / ili.derived_total_cost) AS avg_cost_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Products p ON p.product_id = ili.product_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, p.product_color) g) r WHERE qty_rank <= 3

assumptions.assumption: product_quantity is stored as text and is cast to a number (REAL) for averaging; non-numeric text would be treated as 0 or null depending on the engine.
Rows where derived_total_cost is 0 yield a NULL ratio (division by zero gives NULL, as in SQLite) and are ignored by the average.
Products with a NULL color form their own group and their own rank partition.
